app_fee.value: The Arts & Sciences application fee is $50, and it is not refunded.

toefl_min.value: Arts & Sciences sets a TOEFL iBT composite of 94 (old scale).

also.quote: Our graduate program follows the College of Arts and Sciences English Language Proficiency Policy.

ielts_min.value: Arts & Sciences sets an IELTS overall band of 6.5.

deadline.value: Applications and supporting materials are due January 1 for fall enrollment.
deadline.quote: Applications and all supporting materials are due by the following deadlines: ... Ph.D. Biology - fall enrollment

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional for the Biology PhD, as for most Arts & Sciences programs.
gre_general.quote: It is optional for all other programs.

supervisor.value: Students join the program first and rotate through labs before choosing a major advisor.
supervisor.quote: The Pre-Candidacy Phase includes Course Work, Lab Rotations and Teaching or Research Assistantships

also.quote: Graduate students are strongly encouraged to rotate among different labs during the Pre-Candidacy Phase

funding.value: The department commits to a 12-month stipend for up to five years for students in good standing.
funding.quote: committed to providing a competitive 12-month stipend for up to five years for all graduate students in good standing

entry_route.value: The PhD takes 72 credits beyond a bachelor's or 48 beyond a master's.
entry_route.quote: Admission to Candidacy requires 72 credits beyond the Bachelor’s degree or 48 credits beyond the Master’s degree

gre_subject.value: The Biology pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

notes: Arts & Sciences program. The department page gives the stipend policy; no biology-specific GRE subject test is stated.
